channel.title: The Orange County Register - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Orange County Register (ocregister.com)

item.title: No. 2 UCLA women crush Rutgers for 16th straight win
item.description: Kiki Rice scored 17 points, Gabriela Jaquez adds 14 and the Bruins, who have a key game at Michigan this weekend, dominate another overmatched opponent, 86-46.

item.title: JSerra basketball beats Mater Dei to finish third in Trinity League tournament
item.description: Godschoice Eboigbodin scores 46 points to lead JSerra to a lopsided victory over Mater Dei, which now needs an at-large berth to get into the CIF-SS playoffs.

item.title: Sloppy Clippers buried by Cavaliers to begin post-Harden era
item.description: The Clippers’ 24 turnovers lead to 47 Cleveland points in a 124-91 loss, their first game since sending 11-time All-Star James Harden to the Cavaliers in a trade for Darius Garland.

item.title: 6 Turpin children to split $13.5 million lawsuit settlement over placement with abusive Riverside County foster parents
item.description: Riverside County will pay $2.25 million, while foster family agency ChildNet agreed to pay $11.25 million, the settlement agreement states.

item.title: Kings follow big acquisition with loss to Kraken
item.description: Andrei Kuzmenko scores two power-play goals on his 30th birthday, but the Kings can’t generate anything else in a 4-2 loss just hours after they added high-scoring winger Artemi Panarin in a trade with the Rangers.

item.title: Sonora girls wrestling earns CIF-SS Dual Meet title with victory over Huntington Beach
item.description: Sonora gets six victories by pin in the CIF-SS Dual Meet Finals to capture the Division 4 title.

item.title: Edison girls soccer stuns Huntington Beach in OT thriller for league title
item.description: Sadie Olivares scores a golden goal in the 93rd minute as the Edison claims its first Sunset League title since 2017.

item.title: South Torrance wrestling defeats El Dorado for sixth CIF-SS Dual Meet title in eight years
item.description: South Torrance adds another CIF-SS Dual Meet Championship to its collection with a win over El Dorado on Wednesday.

item.title: St. John Bosco wrestling defeats Esperanza in CIF-SS Division 1 dual meet final
item.description: The two teams split the first two bouts, but then St. John Bosco dominates the rest of the way to capture the title.

item.title: Santa Margarita basketball knocks off St. John Bosco to win Trinity League tournament
item.description: Santa Margarita makes a late surge to take the lead and holds on to win the first Trinity League tournament.
